Street, dealer and traffic rolls use only `EventService.getLuck()` (StreetSpawnService.luau:284, DealershipService.luau:943, TrafficService.luau:785), and spawns are shared across the server, not per player.
failureScenario: Players rebirth partly for the luck boost and get nothing. The Rebirth screen makes a false promise.
suggestedFix: Either remove the luck line from the Rebirth menu, or implement it as a per-player bonus that is actually personal: for example, boost mutation rolls on that player's daily, playtime and referral cars (`Rolls.mutation(1 + rebirths × 0.1)`) or their hot-drop rolls.
verifyReason: Confirmed. VehicleClient.exit (1178-1186) only re-enables Jumping and sets Humanoid.Jump. On the server, onOccupantChanged with a nil occupant (864-869) only calls setDriver(nil); nudgeOut runs only through kickOccupant(car, true), i.e. eject or unauthorized occupants. Nothing on the client repositions the character (CombatClient handles knockback only). The seat top is clamped between 0.45 and beltY-0.2 (CarBuilder 752), inside the collidable chassis box (for example 0.9-2.7), and every visible body part is non-collidable. After the jump the character resolves onto the chassis top, inside the visible cabin with its head through the roof.
fix: In src/server/Systems/VehicleService.luau onOccupantChanged, in the humanoid == nil branch: if car.driver is set, take char = car.driver.Character. If that character's Humanoid has no SeatPart (it has not just sat in another seat), call nudgeOut(car, char) before setDriver(car, nil). nudgeOut is a local defined above (line 725) and is already raycast-safe.

summary: The 'Lose the Cops' product charges Robux even when the player has no wanted level.
evidence: MonetizationService.luau:341-349: the handler treats `callSystem("WantedService","clear",...)` returning ok (pcall success) as a grant. WantedService.luau:351 `if not st or st.stars == 0 then return end` makes no change and raises no error, so the handler returns true and shows 'The cops lost your trail. You're clean!'. The Store card's BUY button (MenuController.luau:1428-1462, promptPurchase 1391-1400) is never disabled based on the Wanted attribute.
failureScenario: A player taps BUY on 'Lose the Cops' while clean, or a cooldown clears the stars just before the receipt is processed. They pay Robux and get nothing, which goes against SPEC §9's honest store.
suggestedFix: In the handler, return false (NotProcessedYet) when `WantedService.getStars(player) == 0`. In the Store, disable or grey out the card with '😇 Not wanted' while the Wanted attribute is 0.
verifyReason: Confirmed but narrow. pushOut uses a raw carModel:PivotTo, and nothing calls VehicleService.teleport or resetWatchdog. From back slots (±33, 38) to the push spot (0/±7, -58) is about 100 studs. With dt≈0.5 the allowance is cap·0.5+10, which is below 100 when topSpeed is under about 85, so slow cars get a 'teleport' verdict. violate() then rewinds them to wdCFrame inside the garage and holds server ownership for 2 s; the next pushOut moves them out again. At the end of the revoke, wdCFrame is reset to the current pose, so it is a single rubber-band with one warn, not spam. It only happens when a lock lands during a theft of a slow car from a back slot, and the F3 fix removes it.
fix: This is covered by the F3 fix in src/server/Systems/PlotService.luau: eject from Stolen cars, and move any other car with VehicleService.teleport(car, cf), which calls resetWatchdog. As a general rule, server code outside VehicleService must never PivotTo a driven Workspace.Vehicles model directly.

summary: Rebirth is a bad deal once a player owns good cars, and the ×4 cost growth stalls progression around R6-R7, which hurts 28-day retention.
evidence: Economy.luau:117-119 sets base 750K, growth ×4, and +0.5 additive income per rebirth. RebirthService.luau:82-113 `_plan` keeps a single car. Costs by rebirth: R1 750K, R3 12M, R5 192M, R6 768M, R7 3.07B, R8 12.3B, R9 49B. A full garage of 12 Mythics earns about $75K/s base (×3.5 at R5 ≈ $265K/s), so R6→R7 takes about 3h and R8→R9 about 90h of income, while each rebirth also throws away 11 cars. Rebirth 1 with 10 Mythics (about $50K/s) drops you to 6000×1.5 = $9K/s.
failureScenario: Mid-game players stop rebirthing, because the +50% multiplier costs about 80% of their income. Late-game players hit a wall around week 1-2, and the rebirth pillar stops providing goals.
suggestedFix: Lower REBIRTH_COST_GROWTH to about 2.5-3. Make the bonus compound (×1.35 per rebirth) or larger. Keep the top 2-3 cars, or keep rarity tiers for which the Index is complete. Show 'income after rebirth' in the menu so the trade-off is clear.
verifyReason: Confirmed. driveSlot (GarageService 883-950) checks only that the player is not driving and is near or in the plot, then spawns at plotToWorld(index, DRIVE_OUT_SPAWN) with no overlap check and seats the player. There is no one-car-out rule (ps.outCars is per slot). An exited Owned car stays put until OWNED_RETURN_AFTER=20 s (VehicleService 1648-1651), and it never counts as delivered while leftGarage is false. So 'Drive A, press F, Drive B' spawns B inside A, both unanchored, and depenetration flings them.
fix: In src/server/Systems/GarageService.luau driveSlot, before setting ps.states[slot]/removeDisplay: for each car in ps.outCars with no driver that is not destroyed, park it home, reusing onDelivery's Owned branch (car.data.delivered=true; destroyCar(car,'parked'); ps.outCars[s]=nil; GarageService.restoreSlot(player, s)). Then run Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox over the spawn footprint (about Length×Width×6 at the DRIVE_OUT_SPAWN world CFrame) with OverlapParams Include {VehicleService.getFolder()}. If anything is still there, notify 'Clear the exit first!' and return false.

summary: Playtime gifts reset every session, so you can rejoin and farm a free Rare, Epic and Legendary car (or about $150K-230K as the full-garage cash fallback) every hour, even while AFK.

summary: The 'steal' contract counts when you hotwire, not when you deliver (against pillar 1), and it can be farmed. The stat flag is global to the server, so whether a hot drop counts as a steal is inconsistent.

verifyReason: Confirmed. The damage accumulator resets to 0 on each ≥0.1 s tick (1735-1738). damagePass compares raw flat Δv between samples with no elapsed time, and the threshold is 55. Brake plus handbrake is about 104 studs/s², so a replication gap or server hitch of about 0.53 s or more during hard braking, or about 0.31 s during a hypercar nitro launch (accel 100×1.8), crosses 55 and applies phantom damage. Rare.

verifyReason: The math and code path are confirmed. The suspension accel (K·comp + C·compVel) does not depend on dt, so clamping dt to MAX_DT has no effect on it. The forces are set once per PreSimulation (VehicleClient 1089) and held for the whole simulated frame. A zero-order-hold analysis with ω²=4K=272 and c=4C=16.8 gives a spectral radius of 0.90 at 9 FPS and 1.57 at 8 FPS, which matches the tracer. Whether it really diverges depends on how much simulated time Roblox advances per frame at about 8 FPS (the engine may throttle). The 0..4g force clamp also bounds it to a hop rather than a true launch. The tracer's 'Stepped substeps' alternative does not exist: Stepped is PreSimulation and fires once per frame.
fix: In src/shared/Vehicle/VehicleController.luau step(): when dtIn > Tuning.MAX_DT, let s = MAX_DT/dtIn and compute the suspension as staticSupport + K·(comp - staticComp)·s² + C·compVel·s, so the static load stays the same and the effective ωT matches 30 FPS. Add a settle-simulation case at 1/8 s in tests/spec/vehicle.spec.luau.

summary: The Rebirth menu's confirm fires a single Rebirth remote. Net's token bucket always drops the first call at 0.5/s, so the button shows 'REBIRTHING...' for 3s and reverts with no feedback (already noted as REBIRTH-RATE-LIMIT-DROPS-FIRST; the client gives no recovery hint).
evidence:
- RebirthService.luau:303-306 registers Net.on("Rebirth", ..., 0.5).
- Net.luau:100-107 creates the bucket with tokens = perSecond (0.5) and rejects when tokens < 1.
- MenuController.luau:2812-2827 fires once, on the second tap.
- MenuController.luau:2834-2840 silently re-enables the button after PENDING_SECONDS.
failureScenario: A player who has saved for a rebirth taps REBIRTH and then TAP AGAIN TO CONFIRM. Nothing happens and there's no toast. They must repeat both taps, which looks like a broken button.

verifyReason: This is a duplicate of REBIRTH-RATE-LIMIT-DROPS-FIRST (docs/integration/findings_contracts.json), which I re-verified. Net.allow creates the bucket with tokens=perSecond=0.5, refills it to min(1, 0.5+0)=0.5 on the first call and rejects when below 1. RebirthService registers at 0.5/s (303-305). MenuController fires Rebirth once on the confirm tap (2812-2817), and tick silently re-enables the button after PENDING_SECONDS (2834-2840). The first-ever rebirth per server session is dropped without feedback; a retry at least 1 s later works.
fix: In Net.allow (src/shared/Net.luau:100), initialise new buckets with `tokens = math.max(1, perSecond)`, which also protects any future sub-1 rates. Alternatively register Rebirth at 1/s in src/server/Systems/RebirthService.luau; RebirthService already has its own busy guard. Track this under the existing REBIRTH-RATE-LIMIT-DROPS-FIRST finding rather than as a new item.

evidence: NotificationController.luau:56-57 (BANNER_POSITION = (0.5, 0.45)), 493-503 (banner build), 620-648 (about 2.25–3s hold each) and 676-678 (queue capped at 6).
failureScenario: A Hot Drop countdown, a 'SECRET car at the Dealership' notice and a HEIST announcement land during a 4★ getaway, giving 6–9s of centre-screen banners over the road ahead.
suggestedFix: While the Driving attribute is true, show a compact banner under the event pills (y≈130), or only the latest item. Keep the full banner for on-foot players.
verifyReason: The code matches the description. BANNER_POSITION is (0.5,0.45); the banner is 740x150 design (about 407x82 real on an 844x390 phone, roughly half the width); it is held 1.1-2.25 s plus about 0.75 s of pop and fade (bannerHold, 129-136); the queue is capped at 6. Nothing changes this while Driving. This is a design trade-off for announcements rather than a defect, so I rate it low.
fix: In NotificationController.showBanner/buildBanner (src/client/Controllers/NotificationController.luau ~493-648), when player:GetAttribute('Driving') is true, set the banner's UIScale target to about 0.6 and position it at UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 150) under the event pills. Shorten holds, e.g. collapse the queue to the latest item while driving.

summary: Every Monetization id is 0, yet garage pads 11–12 permanently advertise '🅿️ +2 SLOTS PASS'. The pass can't be bought and no prompt appears, so it is a visible dead end (SPEC §9 hides id-0 items in the Store).
evidence:
- GarageClient.luau:401-402 sets the pass label whenever PassOnly is true.
- GarageClient.luau:457 only creates the purchase prompt when `Monetization.Passes.slots.id ~= 0`.
- Config/Monetization.luau sets every id to 0 (lines 13–89), and the Store shows 'coming soon'.
failureScenario: A player with 10 slots walks up to pads 11–12 to find out how to unlock them. The pads say '+2 SLOTS PASS', and there is nothing to tap and no store entry.
suggestedFix: When Passes.slots.id == 0, render those pads as '🔒 MAX' or hide them (PlotService/GarageService _padInfo could treat id 0 as not offered).
verifyReason: I confirmed this. renderPad labels every PassOnly pad '🅿️ +2 SLOTS PASS' (GarageClient.luau:401-402), but creates the prompt only when Monetization.Passes.slots.id ~= 0 (457). Every id in Config/Monetization.luau is 0, and the Store hides id-0 items per SPEC. The pads advertise something that can't be bought. This is a pre-launch config state that goes away once ids are filled in, hence low.
fix: In GarageClient.renderPad (src/client/Controllers/GarageClient.luau ~401), when passOnly and Monetization.Passes.slots.id == 0, show icon '🔒' with priceText 'MAX SLOTS' (or 'COMING SOON') in TextDim instead of the pass label.

summary: (Known, but it shows up in this client scenario.) StateController.sanitizeTheft strips dropped and droppedEndsAt. When the thief is knocked out of the car, the HUD keeps showing the long delivery countdown instead of a 'GET BACK IN! 0:12' state.
evidence: StateController.luau:86-96 returns only active, endsAt, carId and targetPlot. TheftService.luau:539-549 sends dropped and droppedEndsAt. HUDController.applyTheft and refreshTheft (1303-1342) can only show endsAt.
failureScenario: A thief gets bonked out of the stolen car. The HUD still says '1:40', but the car returns home in 12–20s, so the player thinks they have time and loses the car.
suggestedFix: Keep dropped and droppedEndsAt in sanitizeTheft. In HUDController, swap the title to 'GET BACK IN!' with a red countdown while dropped is true.
verifyReason: This is a duplicate of THEFTSTATE-DROPPED-STRIPPED, which I re-verified. TheftService.sendThiefState (534-549) sends dropped and droppedEndsAt, but StateController.sanitizeTheft (86-96) keeps only active, endsAt, carId and targetPlot. The HUD therefore can only show the long endsAt countdown. The one existing cue is the 'GET BACK IN!' waypoint label (TheftService ~551).
fix: Track this under THEFTSTATE-DROPPED-STRIPPED. In src/client/Controllers/StateController.luau, keep `dropped = raw.dropped == true` and a finite numeric droppedEndsAt in sanitizeTheft and the TheftState type. In HUDController.applyTheft/refreshTheft (src/client/Controllers/HUDController.luau ~1303-1342), while dropped, show 'GET BACK IN!' with a red countdown to droppedEndsAt.

summary: HUDController.gearAffordable ignores passes.taser, while the Gear Shop treats the Zapper as owned through the pass. Once pass ids are live, Zapper Pass owners get a permanent red '!' on GEAR for a tool they already own.
evidence:
- HUDController.luau:225-230 checks only `not tools[id] and cash >= def.price`.
- MenuController.luau:530 sets `owned = tools[id] == true or (id == "taser" and passes.taser == true)`.
failureScenario: A VIP who bought the Zapper Pass and has $15K sees the GEAR badge pulse and wiggle every 4s. Opening the menu shows ✅ OWNED, so the badge is noise.
suggestedFix: Reuse MenuController.toolRows' ownership rule in gearAffordable, or check snapshot.passes.taser for 'taser'.
verifyReason: I confirmed this. HUDController.gearAffordable (225-230) checks only `not tools[id]`. MenuController.toolRows (530) and ShopService (156) treat taser as owned when the Zapper Pass is held. CombatService.ownedTools grants it at runtime without writing data.tools.taser (711-713), so snapshot.tools.taser stays nil for pass holders. The bug is dormant while the pass id is 0.
fix: In HUDController.gearAffordable (src/client/Controllers/HUDController.luau ~225), read `local passes = if typeof(snapshot.passes) == 'table' then snapshot.passes else {}` and skip a tool when `tools[id] or (id == 'taser' and passes.taser == true)`, matching MenuController.toolRows.

summary: (Extends known PERF-07.) WheelAnimator updates the 25 nearest cars every PreRender with no on-screen check: up to 4 bob raycasts within 140 studs and 4 Weld.C0 writes per car, including server-owned moving traffic and police assemblies. This is the largest steady per-frame client cost on low-end phones.
evidence:
- WheelAnimator.luau:26-28: HOT_COUNT=25, COLD_PER_FRAME=6.
- 425-441: the hot list updates every frame.
- 339-355: raycast per wheel while dist ≤ BOB_RANGE.
- 364: `w.weld.C0 = ...` per wheel per frame.
- 254-277: rebuildNear selects by distance only, with no frustum test.
Other loops (Sound scan at 4 Hz, Effects tags at 4 Hz, Dealership's 8 CFrame writes, Waypoints) are bounded. I found no leaks.
failureScenario: In Rush Hour (36 traffic cars) plus a 4★ chase with police, a low-end Android phone does about 100 raycasts and 100 joint writes per frame on top of the local VehicleController. This causes frame drops right when driving needs to feel best (pillar 2).
suggestedFix: Skip cars whose chassis is off-screen (WorldToViewportPoint), use HOT_COUNT of about 8 on touch, bob-raycast every second or third frame, and prefer Motor6D.Transform over Weld.C0 for per-frame wheel poses.
verifyReason: This duplicates the known PERF-07 (findings_security_perf.json). I re-verified the constants: HOT_COUNT 25, COLD_PER_FRAME 6, BOB_RANGE 140. The hot list is updated every PreRender (425-441) with a per-wheel raycast within BOB_RANGE (339-355) and a weld.C0 write per wheel (364). rebuildNear selects by distance only, with no frustum or device-tier check (254-277). The only new detail is that police assemblies are included, which the existing finding already implies.
